hints: A connected component is a group of cities already mutually reachable.
Find one representative city from each component.
Connect the representatives in a chain; c components need c-1 new roads.
analogy: Join one representative from every disconnected island into a chain.
example: If components are {1,2}, {3}, and {4,5}, roads 2-3 and 3-4 connect all cities using two roads.
algorithm: Run DFS/DSU to collect component representatives; output edges rep[i]-rep[i+1] for consecutive representatives.
correctness: At least c-1 edges are needed to connect c separate components, and a chain uses exactly c-1 while joining all of them.
